license.summary: Quote and cite scores, specs and conclusions with attribution and a link to the source review. Republishing a full review or redistributing the catalogue as a dataset needs written permission.

fields.slug: Stable identifier, also the last path segment of the review URL.
fields.name: Manufacturer model name as reviewed.
fields.score: padel.how score out of 100, from the published methodology.
fields.scores: The ten category scores, each 0-10. Their sum is the score field.
fields.shape: Head shape as measured on the frame.
fields.balance_cm: Balance point in centimetres from the butt.
fields.gender: Model targeting, unisex unless the manufacturer states otherwise.
fields.feel: Position on the feel map. stiffness is 0-100 where 100 is the stiffest frame in the catalogue; power_on_demand is the 0-10 score for how easily the racket gives power; map holds the plotted percentages used on the site.
fields.markdown_url: Markdown version of the same review.
fields.retailers: Where to buy. url is an affiliate link, price is the figure published on the review page on retailers_updated and is not live.
fields.price_range: Lowest and highest published retailer price for this racket.

retailer_note: Retailer links are affiliate links; padel.how may earn a commission from a qualifying purchase. Each price carries the timestamp it was observed at. The same feed is served at /data/offers.json and through the MCP endpoint.
